title: The Complete Inheritance of the Fourth Page
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji believed victory was within reach, a bizarre tremor emanated from the depths of the Tianji Record—the gaze of the Heavenly Eye piercing through the void, locking onto his current position. The final confrontation of fate was now imminent.

text.content: The fourth page of the Tianji Record suddenly blazed with blinding golden light. The fragmented runes writhed and reorganized like living things, weaving before Chen Ji's eyes into a vast scroll of destiny. He saw himself—countless versions of himself, struggling, falling, and reborn across countless timelines. Every fate line ended in death, as if written in advance by an invisible hand. 'So this is... the true form of the Deadly Calamity?' Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly, yet his fingertips remained steady as stone, pressed against the center of the fourth page.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji!' Su Qingyao's cry rang out from afar as she flew on her sword through the air, but the moment she drew near the Tianji Record, she was pushed back three steps by an invisible force. She gritted her teeth, veins bulging at her temples: 'What are you doing?! Why didn't you tell me!' Her eyes were red-rimmed, but she didn't take another step forward—she knew that some inheritances, once interrupted, would have unimaginable consequences.

text.content: The inheritance of the fourth page flooded into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a tide—he saw the true meaning of the destiny writer. It wasn't simple prophecy, but authority above the laws of heaven: every 'result' he inscribed would become part of reality. His meridians screamed in agony as his Heavenly Fate Value drained like a breached dam—the numbers plummeted: 100, 80, 60... 'Worth it.' A cold smile curved his lips, yet his gaze was unprecedentedly clear.

At the moment the Heavenly Fate Value dropped to its critical point, the Tianji Record suddenly stopped its absorption. An aged, familiar voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind: 'Enough. The wheel of fate has begun to turn. From now on, you possess the possibility to rewrite certain death—but remember, every inscription demands a price.' Mo Xiansheng's remnant spirit manifested above the fourth page, gazing at Chen Ji with complex emotions: 'Are you certain you wish to continue?'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji raised his head, staring directly at the illusory figure, his voice terrifyingly calm: 'Master, if I don't write, the outcome was already destined. Rather than waiting passively for death, I'd rather take a chance.' He paused, then suddenly smiled: 'Besides, didn't you say that within the chess game, everything can be calculated? Including this so-called deadly backlash.' Mo Xiansheng's remnant spirit froze momentarily, then let out a meaningful sigh: 'Bold lad... I hope you won't regret this.'

text.content: Su Qingyao finally broke through the barrier, grabbing Chen Ji's wrist, her fingertips cold and trembling: 'You madman! Your Heavenly Fate Value is nearly depleted—do you understand what that means?' Her voice carried a sob: 'Death! You'll die!' Chen Ji looked down at their joined hands, then raised his other hand to cover hers gently: 'That's why I need you to help me.' He looked up, his gaze unprecedentedly serious: 'Qingyao, I need you to become my 'Shared Fate Companion'.'

dialogue.content: 'Shared Fate Companion?' Su Qingyao's eyes widened, immediately understanding the implication—splitting the consumption of Heavenly Fate Value, sharing the bonds of destiny. Once formed, she would be completely bound to Chen Ji's life and death, sharing weal and woe. She fell silent for three full breaths, then suddenly raised her head, eyes glistening with tears yet filled with resolve: 'I agree.' Chen Ji was stunned—he hadn't expected her to agree so readily. Su Qingyao forced out a smile sadder than crying: 'Did you think I investigated you for so long for what reason?'

text.content: The Tianji Record sensed the will of both, and the fourth page erupted with dual-colored light—gold and silver intertwining, weaving a thread of destiny between the two. Su Qingyao felt a torrential force surge into her body—that was Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate Value, slowly flowing toward her. She clenched her teeth, enduring the meridians-tearing agony without uttering a sound. Chen Ji gazed at her pale yet stubborn face, feeling some tender place in his heart being harshly touched: 'Fool.'

choice.prompt: Just as the Shared Fate link was about to complete, Chen Ji sensed the final trial from the depths of the fourth page—the 'first inscription of destiny.' He had to make a choice among the following three paths:

choices.description: Directly inscribe 'Deadly Calamity·Resolved' on the scroll of destiny, rewriting his death ending in the most straightforward way, but at the cost of consuming a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value.
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value plummets, may trigger Tianji Pavilion tracking

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, condensing a brilliant golden light at his fingertip, then forcefully pressed it onto the 'Deadly Calamity' characters on the scroll of destiny. Golden radiance and dark energy collided violently; blood simultaneously poured from all seven orifices as his Heavenly Fate Value plummeted—40, 35, 32... Just as it was about to hit bottom, the silver energy flowing from within Su Qingyao rushed in to replenish in time. The two forces merged, finally completely shredding that mass of dark energy. 'It worked...' Chen Ji collapsed to the ground, yet a victorious smile hung at the corner of his mouth.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao rushed over to support him, her voice trembling: 'You scoundrel! Next time you dare do this... I, I...' She couldn't finish, only hugging him tightly. Chen Ji weakly patted her back: 'Relax, I still owe you a drink.' He raised his head, his gaze penetrating the void toward some distant location: 'However... they're here.'

choices.description: Instead of confronting the Deadly Calamity head-on, search for the gray area between 'calamity' and 'resolution' within the scroll of destiny, using skill to pry open the laws of fate.
choices.visible_reward: Discover a hidden loophole in fate
choices.risk_hint: May expose the existence of the Tianji Record

text.content: Chen Ji didn't choose direct assault. Instead, he submerged his divine sense deep into the scroll of destiny, searching for loopholes in an almost absurd manner. A playful smile hung at the corner of his mouth: 'Deadly Calamity... must... die?' He suddenly burst into laughter, then forcefully added a stroke to the '必' character—turning it into '不必死' (not necessarily die)! At this moment, the Heavenly Dao's laws experienced a momentary disruption, and that deathly aura weakened considerably.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant spirit image trembled violently, emitting a hoarse burst of laughter: 'Good lad... Good lad! Using changes in characters to pry at the foundations of fate—this move, even this old man didn't anticipate!' His phantom suddenly solidified somewhat: 'Remember this loophole—it can only be used once. Next time when the death calamity returns, that will be the moment you truly face the Heavenly Eye.' As his words fell, the fourth page slammed shut with a thunderous sound, and Chen Ji felt an unprecedented power flowing within him.

choices.description: Not clinging to rewriting the destined death itself, but breaking free from the chessboard set by Heavenly Providence, reshaping one's fate trajectory in a higher dimension.
choices.risk_hint: May Trigger Direct Gaze from Heavenly Providence's Eye

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly closed his eyes, his consciousness breaking free from the Tianji Record's bindings, surging toward a higher dimensional space. There, he saw the entire chessboard—the magnificent game laid out by Heavenly Providence's Eye, with countless pieces living and dying within it. And finally, he saw his own position. Without hesitation, with a near-mad posture, he overturned the chessboard before him. Pieces scattered, time and space twisted, and Chen Ji felt himself breaking free from the identity of a mere piece.

dialogue.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to complete his transformation, a terrifying will beyond words descended abruptly. It was Heavenly Providence's Eye—it opened from the endless Void, gazing upon this ant who dared challenge the rules of the chess game. A world-destroying pressure swept over them. Su Qingyao let out a miserable scream, blown away by the force. Chen Ji was covered in blood, yet still stood straight, laughing wildly at the sky: 'Look... finally, you truly see me!'

text.content: Regardless of which path was chosen, the Fourth Page Inheritance was finally completed. Chen Ji felt an unprecedented power flowing through his body—the complete authority of a Fate Writer. He could clearly see every node on his fate line, every possible branch, every upcoming crisis and opportunity. But at the same time, he felt two炽热的注视 burning from distant places: from the direction of the Tianji Pavilion, someone was watching; from the higher dimensional Void, Heavenly Providence's Eye's will was gathering.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao struggled to her feet, supporting the swaying Chen Ji, her eyes full of worry: 'Do you feel it? Those two auras...' Chen Ji nodded, his voice eerily calm: 'Tianji Pavilion and Heavenly Providence's Eye, both have their eyes on us.' He suddenly smiled, the expression carrying a hint of madness and anticipation: 'Interesting, it seems my life is quite valuable.' He turned to Su Qingyao, his gaze suddenly softening: 'But right now, what I care more about is—are you okay?'

text.content: Su Qingyao was struck by his tenderness, her eyes instantly reddening. She fiercely punched Chen Ji's chest: 'You bastard! At a time like this, you're still thinking about these things!' Chen Ji coughed twice from her punches but laughed even more brilliantly: 'Because you're my life-sharing companion, if you die, I won't survive either.' He paused, his gaze turning profound: 'So from now on, I will cherish this life more than ever. Not for myself, but to protect you.'

At that moment, the Fifth Page position of the Tianji Record flickered, and a blurred image emerged—a vast star domain, with an ancient palace suspended at its center. On the palace's plaque were three chilling characters: Heavenly Providence Palace. 'This is... the本体 of Heavenly Providence's Eye?' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Mr. Mo's voice sounded opportunely: 'The Fifth Page Inheritance will teach you how to face true Heavenly Providence. But before that, you need to complete obtaining the Seventh Page—there lies the key to reversing everything.'

choice.prompt: Facing Heavenly Providence's Eye's gaze and Mr. Mo's hints, Chen Ji needed to make the next strategic deployment. The time left for him was running out—

choices.description: Seize the Seventh Page before Heavenly Providence's Eye fully locks on, firmly grasping the initiative of destiny in your own hands.
choices.risk_hint: May Encounter Ambush from Tianji Pavilion Master

dialogue.content: "No more waiting." A sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, his tone decisive. "Rather than being passively beaten, better to strike first. If Tianji Pavilion wants my life, let's see if they have the ability to take it." Su Qingyao opened her mouth, wanting to dissuade him, but when she met those profound eyes like deep abysses, she swallowed all her words. She took a deep breath: "I'm coming with you." Chen Ji smiled, that smile carrying a hint of dominance and tenderness: "Good, let's go together."

choices.description: The Fourth Page Inheritance just completed and needs time to digest. Silently accumulate strength, wait for a better opportunity to act.
choices.visible_reward: Ability Consolidation, May Trigger Hidden Plot
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Providence's Eye May Strike First

dialogue.content: Chen Ji pressed his hand on Su Qingyao's shoulder, his gaze calm: 'Don't be impatient, one must eat meals one bite at a time. Charging in now would only be seeking death.' He sat cross-legged and began circulating his cultivation technique to digest the Fourth Page Inheritance. Su Qingyaowas momentarily stunned，随即也坐下，默默地守在他身侧。良久，陈机睁开眼，嘴角勾起一抹meaningful的笑：「有意思……这第四页里，居然还藏着一个关于天机阁的秘密。」

choices.description: Ye Qing's 'Demonic Mist' can conceal the aura of the Tianji Record, and it's the key to countering the gaze of the Heavenly Eye. Find her for an alliance first.
choices.visible_reward: With the cover of Demonic Mist, actions will be more covert
choices.risk_hint: Need to reveal more trump cards to Ye Qing

dialogue.content: Chen Ji drew out a pitch-black communication Jade Slip from his chest, a playful glint flickering in his eyes: 'Miss Ye Qing, satisfied with our last deal, I hope? Now, I have a bigger business proposition for you.' Silence hung on the other end of the Jade Slip for a moment, before Ye Qing's languid yet wary voice came through: 'Chen Ji? You dare contact me again? Go on, what business?' Chen Ji's lips curved upward: 'Help me conceal my Heavenly Secrets aura, and in exchange—I'll tell you the weakness of the Heavenly Eye.' The Jade Slip fell suddenly silent, even the breathing on the other end growing急促.

text.content: The moment Chen Ji made his choice, in an ice-sealed palace in the extreme north, the eyelids of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion Master quivered slightly. An aged yet authoritative voice reverberated through the main hall: 'Interesting... the fourth page's inheritance, that这小子 actually completed it.' He raised his hand, a point of light condensing at his fingertip, precisely marking Chen Ji's current location: 'Issue the order—the First Sequence of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion shall mobilize immediately. Target—Chen Ji. Alive.'

Meanwhile, in a higher-dimensional Void, the true form of the Heavenly Eye finally opened completely. It was an existence beyond human comprehension, its 'gaze' piercing through layers of barriers, fixing directly upon Chen Ji. An indescribable oppressive sensation surged like a tide, Chen Ji groaned, the veins at his temples bulging. Su Qingyao cried out in alarm, gripping his hand tightly: 'Chen Ji! What's wrong?' Chen Ji gritted his teeth, his voice scraping through clenched teeth: 'It... is looking at me.'

dialogue.content: At this critical moment, the Tianji Record suddenly burst forth with a radiant curtain of light, enveloping Chen Ji and Su Qingyao within. The oppressive sensation was temporarily blocked, yet Chen Ji clearly felt—the Heavenly Eye's gaze not only didn't weaken, but grew even more intense. A voice transcending language rang directly in his mind: 'Interesting... another ant attempting to break free from the chessboard. But do you truly believe toppling the board will change destiny?' The voice carried eternal coldness and mockery: 'A chess piece, after all, is merely a chess piece.'

text.content: Chen Ji was shaken by that voice until blood flowed from all seven orifices, yet he still threw his head back in wild laughter, his mirth both mad and tragic: 'A chess piece? Then let this piece—checkmate you first!' He urgently activated the authority of the fourth page, writing four characters on the scroll of destiny—'Heavenly Retribution'! In that instant, that transcendent dimensional existence actually exhibited a momentary pause. Though merely the blink of an eye, it was enough for Chen Ji to seize upon—within that absolute power—a trace of a flaw.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying unprecedented gravity: 'Boy, have you gone mad? Revealing the ability of a Fate Weaver before the Heavenly Eye, do you understand what that means?' Chen Ji coughed up a mouthful of blood, yet his smile grew ever brighter: 'What does it mean? It means it's finally deigned to look at me properly.' He slowly straightened his body, his gaze piercing through the Void, locking eyes with the Heavenly Eye across the distance: 'You want to know if a chess piece can defeat a chess player? Then watch closely—I, Chen Ji, from this day forward, will be no one's chess piece!'

The Tianji Record bloomed with radiance never before seen, the barrier between the fourth and fifth pages beginning to loosen. Chen Ji sensed an entirely new power awakening within him—authority surpassing even Fate Writing, capable of rewriting the laws of Heaven itself. Yet at the same time, he felt the breath of death drawing near. The Heavenly Eye would not tolerate a challenger surviving long, and the hunting squad from the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion was already on its way. The final confrontation of destiny loomed imminent.
